theme.designMd:
# Portfolio Scrollytelling Design System

Polished, professional dark UI. Calm reveals, restrained motion, content first.
Carries over the current site look: slate background, emerald accent.

## Colors
| Role | Hex |
|---|---|
| Background | #0F172A (slate-900) |
| Background deep | #020617 (slate-950) |
| Surface / card | #1E293B (slate-800) |
| Border | #334155 (slate-700) |
| Text | #F1F5F9 |
| Muted text | #CBD5E1 |
| Accent (emerald) | #34D399 -> #059669 gradient, used for highlighted words and the active progress dot |

## Typography
Inter. H1 56px/1.2, H2 32px/1.3, body 18px/1.6, labels 12px uppercase tracking-wide. Highlighted words (`<b>`) use the emerald gradient.

## Shape and spacing
Radius 12px. 8px spacing grid. Thin 1px borders, soft shadows, no glows.

## Layout and motion
- Desktop: two columns. Text steps scroll on the left, the visual stays pinned on the right (sticky, 100svh).
- Mobile: stacked, no pinning, visual sits inline above each step.
- Slim progress rail on the right edge: one dot per chapter, active dot is emerald, labels on hover. Becomes a top progress bar on mobile.
- Starfield particles stay as the fixed backdrop.
- Motion: fades and small translates under 0.5s; inactive steps at 25% opacity. All motion off under prefers-reduced-motion.

## Chapters
1. Hello: name, role, tagline.
2. Person: hobbies (video games, camping, kayaking) and mentoring. Photos on the sticky panel.
3. Career: pinned timeline. Each step swaps the sticky card (company, role, period, stack).
4. Skills + AI: steps through Frontend, Backend, Cloud and DevOps, Testing, then "How I work with AI". Sticky panel shows tech logos, then an AI workflow diagram.
5. Contact: links and CV downloads.

screens.prompt:
Design the mobile stacked version of the Career chapter. 

Key Requirements:
1. Top Scroll Progress Bar: A thin fixed bar at the very top of the viewport (height 2-3px) in vibrant emerald (#34D399) reflecting scroll progress across the chapter.
2. Header & Chapter intro: Refined TopAppBar with career chapter title and resume/CV download action. Chapter indicator '02 — CAREER', large bold headline 'Selected Experience & Milestones', with a brief narrative subheading on building scalable digital products and design engineering.
3. Mobile Stacked Layout (Strictly No Pinning): Each career milestone is an individual, vertically stacked card with subtle slate container border (border-slate-800/80), dark glass surface (bg-slate-900/80 or bg-slate-900), comfortable touch padding, and clean typography.
4. Content per Career Card:
   - Header with company name, company icon/avatar placeholder, company badge or status (e.g. 'Present', 'Series B', 'Enterprise'), role title (e.g. 'Staff Product Designer & Design Engineer', 'Senior UX/UI Lead', 'Frontend Specialist').
   - Period / Dates clearly visible (e.g., '2022 — Present · 2 yrs 4 mos', '2019 — 2022 · 3 yrs', '2017 — 2019 · 2 yrs').
   - Location & employment type tag (e.g., 'San Francisco, CA · Hybrid', 'New York, NY · Remote').
   - High-impact bullet points summarizing key achievements (metrics, leadership, design systems, architectural impact).
   - Horizontal wrap of tech stack & skill chips with micro-icons (e.g., 'Next.js', 'TypeScript', 'Tailwind CSS', 'Figma Tokens', 'GraphQL', 'Design Systems', 'React Native').
5. Interactive & Visual Polish:
   - Subtle vertical connecting guide line or index markers (01, 02, 03, 04) connecting the journey down the screen.
   - Clean footer / bottom navigation integration matching BottomNavBar.
   - Visual consistency with Portfolio Scrollytelling design system (Dark slate, emerald #34D399 accent, rounded-xl/2xl cards, crisp typography).
screens.title: Career — Mobile Stacked Chapter

outputComponents.text:
Here is the mobile stacked version of the **Career** chapter (`Career — Mobile Stacked Chapter`), tailored for natural vertical mobile scrolling:

### Design Highlights
- **Top Scroll Progress Bar**: A sleek emerald (`#34D399`) indicator fixed to the top edge that tracks scroll progression through the timeline.
- **Vertical Stacked Architecture (No Pinning)**: Replaces horizontal pinned panels with fluid, responsive card modules arranged in a cohesive sequential timeline.
- **Timeline & Milestone Hierarchy**: Step numbers (`01`, `02`, `03`, `04`) with subtle vertical connector nodes leading through each career chapter.
- **Rich Card Details**: Each card showcases company branding, employment badges, exact tenure/period, location tags, quantified impact bullet points, and tech stack chips.
- **Visual Continuity**: Retains the portfolio's signature dark slate palette, emerald highlights, refined typography, and quick-action resume download module.

outputComponents.suggestion: Add interactive expand/collapse toggles for card details
Add filter chips for design vs. engineering roles
Create the next chapter: Skills & Stack mobile view
